name: Demis Hassabis
tagline: unifying neuroscience and AI to solve intelligence.
subtitle: Neuro-symbolic AI & DeepMind
bio: Demis Hassabis is the Research Lead for the Statistics Programming Club. As the CEO and Co-founder of Google DeepMind, he is a world leader in artificial intelligence research, specifically in combining neuroscience insights with deep learning to solve fundamental problems of intelligence.
